description: This PHP class 'ConvertDecimal' provides methods to convert decimal numbers to binary, hexadecimal, and octal representations, including handling of negative numbers using two's complement notation. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation engine for engineering functions.

classes.name: ConvertDecimal
classes.description: A class for converting decimal numbers to binary, hexadecimal, and octal formats, supporting negative number representation and array inputs.

methods.name: toBinary
methods.description: Converts a decimal number to its binary representation, supporting negative numbers with two's complement.

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Converts a decimal number to its hexadecimal representation, supporting negative numbers with two's complement.

methods.name: hex32bit
methods.description: Handles 32-bit hexadecimal formatting for negative and large numbers.

methods.name: toOctal
methods.description: Converts a decimal number to its octal representation, supporting negative numbers with two's complement.

methods.name: validateDecimal
methods.description: Validates that the input string is a proper decimal number.
